extracted.name: Sweet potato jacket with blue cheese, bacon, pecans & cranberries
extracted.description: Liven up a baked sweet potato with these punchy flavours. Use a pre-baked sweet potato to save time
ingredient_lines: maple syrup and pecans, to serve
instruction_lines: Split the baked sweet potatoes down the middle and stuff each one with bacon. Top with the soured cream, crumbled cheese and cranberries. Crush the pecans in your hands and scatter over the potatoes with some black pepper. Drizzle with a little maple syrup if you have a sweet tooth.
